decisions.evidence: Overall, the three toxic neighbors mostly separate the query from larger, more lipophilic, and more flexible toxic analogs, while the three not-toxic neighbors show that the query’s small size, low surface area, lower logP, and generally restrained property profile fit better with the non-toxic class despite the shared hydroxamic acid alert. The repeated absence of a strong lipophilicity/size burden, together with the generally favorable scaffold descriptors across the not-toxic comparisons, makes option (A) the better final prediction.
